notes:
I couldn't write any notes for Psalm 126, because I wasn't able to read any of the sources.

On my first try I asked for eight pages at once: Enduring Word; Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Matthew Henry on Bible Hub; Precept Austin; the NET Bible notes; and Augustine on New Advent. That request hit the tool's usage limit and returned nothing. When I tried to fetch one page on its own, the tool told me I had no calls left for this turn. So I haven't read a single page.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, with a link for every point. Because of that, I haven't filled the gap from memory or made up notes or URLs.

If you send the request again, I'll fetch the pages one or two at a time so I don't hit the limit. I'd start with the traditional reading, then go to the different Protestant traditions, then the other views. If there are particular pages you most want covered first, tell me and I'll start with those.
